titleEn: Maximum Elegance of a K-Length Subsequence
title: 子序列最大优雅度
summary: 从物品中选恰好 k 个，优雅度为利润和加不同类别数的平方，求最大优雅度。
insight: 先按利润降序选前 k 个，得到最大初始利润和；同类别的重复选择把利润放入小根堆。继续扫描较低利润物品，遇到新类别时可用它替换最小重复利润，使类别数加一，并在每次替换后更新优雅度。
pitfalls: 必须恰好选择 k 个
只可替换已选重复类别物品
重复利润堆要弹出最小值
利润和与平方使用 long

solutions.title: 利润排序替换最小重复项
solutions.idea: 在利润损失最小的前提下逐步增加类别数。
steps: 选前 k 项并累计 sum
首次类别加入集合，重复类别利润加入小根堆
扫描剩余物品，若类别新且堆非空
弹出最小重复利润并换入当前物品

code.java: class Solution { public long findMaximumElegance(int[][] items,int k){Arrays.sort(items,(a,b)->Integer.compare(b[0],a[0]));Set<Integer> categories=new HashSet<>();PriorityQueue<Integer> duplicates=new PriorityQueue<>();long sum=0;for(int i=0;i<k;i++){sum+=items[i][0];if(!categories.add(items[i][1]))duplicates.add(items[i][0]);}long answer=sum+(long)categories.size()*categories.size();for(int i=k;i<items.length&&!duplicates.isEmpty();i++)if(!categories.contains(items[i][1])){sum+=items[i][0]-duplicates.poll();categories.add(items[i][1]);answer=Math.max(answer,sum+(long)categories.size()*categories.size());}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findMaximumElegance(items:Array<IntArray>,k:Int):Long{items.sortWith(Comparator{a,b->b[0].compareTo(a[0])});val categories=HashSet<Int>();val duplicates=java.util.PriorityQueue<Int>();var sum=0L;for(i in 0 until k){sum+=items[i][0];if(!categories.add(items[i][1]))duplicates.add(items[i][0])};var answer=sum+categories.size.toLong()*categories.size;var i=k;while(i<items.size&&duplicates.isNotEmpty()){if(items[i][1] !in categories){sum+=items[i][0]-duplicates.poll();categories.add(items[i][1]);answer=maxOf(answer,sum+categories.size.toLong()*categories.size)};i++};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long findMaximumElegance(vector<vector<int>>& items,int k){sort(items.begin(),items.end(),[](auto& a,auto& b){return a[0]>b[0];});unordered_set<int> categories;priority_queue<int,vector<int>,greater<int>> duplicates;long long sum=0;for(int i=0;i<k;++i){sum+=items[i][0];if(!categories.insert(items[i][1]).second)duplicates.push(items[i][0]);}long long answer=sum+(long long)categories.size()*(long long)categories.size();for(int i=k;i<(int)items.size()&&!duplicates.empty();++i)if(!categories.count(items[i][1])){sum+=items[i][0]-duplicates.top();duplicates.pop();categories.insert(items[i][1]);answer=max(answer,sum+(long long)categories.size()*(long long)categories.size());}return answer;} };
